name: pragmatic
description: Draw and edit pragmatic boards and docs from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your pragmatic server. Claude can draw boards from prompts, rebuild screenshots as editable diagrams, write docs and manage tasks. On first use a browser page asks you to sign in to pragmatic and allow access.

server_url.title: pragmatic MCP address
server_url.description: Copy it from Settings & Claude in pragmatic. It ends in /mcp, for example http://localhost:3100/mcp.
